title: Variables reset at the start of every loop iteration
statement: Every time a loop body starts again, the variables changed inside it go back to what they were before the loop.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: trace an accumulator updated inside a loop
evidence_patterns.signature: reports the value from a single iteration rather than the accumulated value

example.item:
total = 0
for n in [1, 2, 3]:
    total = total + n
print(total)

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent across accumulator items; the learner explains that the loop 'starts over'. A slip is an arithmetic error in the running total.

vs.prog.var.variable-keeps-history: History-keepers report too many values; resetters report only the last iteration's contribution.

conflicts_with.label: A variable holds exactly one value at a time
A loop checks its condition only at defined points and repeats its whole body

resolved_by.label: A variable holds exactly one value at a time
A loop checks its condition only at defined points and repeats its whole body
